justification: The lineup is the brand this week, full stop: Stroud, Jefferson, Barkley, Kittle, McMillan and Allgeier — the household names and the redemption arcs — all stay exactly where they are, because Tyler Allgeier just dropped 33.6 on a cover story I personally funded with my last dollar, and a man riding a highlight like that gets his two weeks of blind starts, no debate, no spreadsheet override. Philly's defense and Trey Smack round it out because this is a cohesive mood board, not a committee meeting, and every slot has to look right before Sunday even kicks off — growth week energy, but this time with receipts.
